name: Kaleidoscope Layers
description: A digital face over a shape kaleidoscope the watch draws live on three see-through canvas layers: every wake or tap brings new colours and shapes that fly in, turn and settle.

steps.script:
project.appId = 1133691; await registerCustomFont({ name: 'open-sans-400.ttf', family: 'Open Sans Regular', format: 'truetype', ext: '.ttf', dataBase64: '' });
    await document.fonts.load('80px "Open Sans Regular"'); return 1

for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) { const e = await addElement('CANVAS', { x: 0, y: 0, w: 390, h: 450, show: 'normal', handle: 'k' + i }); Object.assign(e, { x: 0, y: 0, name: 'Kaleidoscope canvas ' + i }) } return 3
const t = await addElement('TEXT', { x: 0, y: 0, w: 390, h: 450, text: '', show: 'normal', handle: 'tap' }); Object.assign(t, { x: 0, y: 0, name: 'Tap for a new pattern' }); return 1
